text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Incident created: Elevated 5xx + 429 cascade reported by monitoring (alerts: gateway-5xx-rate, quota-errors-high)

alex: getting alerts for a spike in 5xx from the API gateway and a huge concurrent 429 spike. seeing a lot of timeouts too.

maria: same, dashboards show gateway 5xx rate jump at 12:03 UTC and quotas hitting hard around the same time.

jamal: paging oncall (taking first pass) — I’m in. can someone paste the top errors?

leo: logs snippet:```
[12:03:12] gateway: 429 Too Many Requests - tenant=acme-corp route=/v1/generate count=523
[12:03:13] runtime: 503 Backend error - model-pool=redwood-low qps=1200
[12:03:14] cache: timeout fetching prefix - 504
```

sophia: looks like a quota enforcement rule kicked in then downstream services started failing. probable cascade: quota->429->backpressure->5xx.

jamal: +1. check quota config for the gateway/tenant policy. @ken can you pull the quota policy and any recent changes?

ken: pulling config now. found a recent rollout at 11:58 UTC that modified the global per-tenant burst cap. rollout id: rollout-2024-11-quota. snippet:```yaml
policies:
  - name: per-tenant-burst
    limit: 100
    window: 60s
    apply_to: all-tiers
```

ken: that limit of 100 looks wrong for the high-throughput tenants — should be 1000. CI change slipped with a bad default.

priya: omg that would explain the immediate 429 flood. are we able to roll that change back?

alex: can we hotfix the policy to increase limit and re-evaluate? what's the risk?

jamal: plan: (1) temporarily lift per-tenant burst to 2000 for prod (2) scale up gateway frontends by +2 instances (3) enable fallback routing to next-best model for heavy tenants to reduce backend QPS. executing now.

maria: notifying CS/ops for impacted customers list. prepping customer-notify draft.

deploy-bot: start: config-apply rollout-2024-11-quota-hotfix by jamal (manual approval not required)

ken: applying hotfix... applying to region us-east-1 first.```

ken: applied hotfix in us-east-1 at 12:12 UTC. increasing limit to 2000.

deploy-bot: success: config-apply rollout-2024-11-quota-hotfix completed in us-east-1

leo: observing immediate drop in 429s in us-east-1: from ~1200/s to ~80/s over two minutes. 5xx rate dropping too.

jamal: scaling gateway instances now (autoscale requests).

sophia: routing adjustment: enabling model-fallback rule for tenants above threshold to use quantized-variant-1 to reduce backend load.

alex: good. any sign of customer impact besides transient errors? Maria — CS?

maria: CS: receiving increased inbound support tickets from 3 enterprise customers reporting degraded responses between 12:03-12:15 UTC. no data loss. sending templated status update.

priya: started incident channel with account teams, notifying impacted customers and offering retries.

jamal: monitoring metrics: latency 95th plummeting back toward baseline, error budget burn slowing.

ken: rolling change to other regions now (us-west-2, eu-west-1). will take ~5m each.

deploy-bot: started: config-apply rollout-2024-11-quota-hotfix in us-west-2

leo: us-west-2 shows similar improvement after rollout. eu-west-1 looks good on initial check.

jamal: ok, mitigation seems effective. root cause = bad default introduced in quota rollout that set per-tenant burst to 100 instead of 1000 for all tiers. cascade = quota enforcements (429) -> gateway/backpressure -> backend 5xx/timeouts.

alex: next actions: (a) revert bad defaults in infra as code (b) add unit test on quota defaults in rollout CI (c) run tabletop with SRE/Quota team. assign owners.

ken: I’ll create a PR to fix the IaC defaults and tag CI to block.

sophia: I’ll follow up with a postmortem + timeline; include graphs for 429->5xx correlation and the rollout diff.

maria: CS follow-up: sending customers a post-incident note with timeline and mitigation steps.

jamal: handing off to sophia for postmortem/cleanup. I’ll remain available for follow-ups. oncall status: jamal -> sophia (handoff complete) :handshake:

incident-bot: pager cleared for jamal, new owner: sophia

sophia: taking over. last check: error rates stable, no active page, customer impact limited to transient errors. will keep channel open until tomorrow.

alex: thanks team. please record any stray logs or anomalous traces in the postmortem doc.

priya: quick action items summary: - hotfix applied (limits -> 2000) - gateway scaled +2 - model fallback enabled - affected customers notified - IaC default PR open - postmortem assigned to sophia

sophia: adding timeline & mitigation notes to the incident tracker and will schedule a 30m retro. closing channel for active mitigation. reopen if more noise.

alex: resolved for now. great coordination. :tada:
